name: Loktak Heritage Weekend
description: Three days of boat races, lake ecology walks and fisher community events on the Loktak shore.

name: Ukhrul District Cultural Week
description: Tangkhul music, weaving demonstrations and village open days across the district headquarters.

name: Imphal Heritage Walk Weekend
description: Guided walks across the Second World War circuit and central Imphal heritage sites.

name: Andro Craft Mela
description: Pottery and craft fair with artisan household demonstrations and direct sales.

name: Ningol Chakouba
description: Major family festival observed across the valley. Dates follow the traditional calendar and should be confirmed each year.

name: Sangai Festival
description: The flagship state tourism festival, usually held in late November. Exact dates and venues are announced by the department each year.

name: Tamenglong Orange Festival
description: Annual orange harvest festival in the western hills, and the busiest visitor window in the district.

name: Khongjom Day
description: State commemoration of the 1891 battle, observed annually on 23 April at the memorial complex.

name: Shirui Lily Festival
description: Annual festival built around the flowering window of the Shirui lily. It is also the period of highest pressure on the habitat.

name: Luira Phanit
description: Tangkhul seed sowing festival marking the start of the agricultural year across the district.
